traps: pyproject.toml and package.json at the root both name their unit wger: the frameworks of either side carry the same unit name
React has no dependency of its own: the prebuilt bundle of @wger-project/react-components (a devDependency) is loaded by wger/core/templates/template.html
there is no compose file for the application: databases, Redis and mail come from environment variables in settings/main.py, and settings/local_dev.py switches between SQLite and PostgreSQL
the only compose file, extras/open-food-facts/docker-compose.yml, starts MongoDB and Mongo Express to import the Open Food Facts dump
exercises and ingredients are synchronised from another instance, https://wger.de by default (WGER_INSTANCE), and from PowerSync when POWERSYNC_URL is set
the CAPTCHA is reCAPTCHA or Cloudflare Turnstile depending on CAPTCHA_PROVIDER; tests use Django's TestCase, there is no pytest
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
